title: round.json
description: A round of a work: its number, its phase, the design it was made on, its questions in groups, a run of the evaluator for each, and what the rounds before it came to.

design.description: the SHA-256 of the design tree the round was made on

content.description: the last content round before this one: the design it was made on, and whether it met every question; null where none was made

reading_met.description: whether the last reading round since that content round met every question; null where none was made
